title: Data Scientist
jobDescription:

Its not just about your career or job titleIts about who you are and the impact you will make on the world. Because whether its for each other or our customers, we put People First. Role Summary/Purpose
The Wabtec Data & Analytics (D&A) team is driving the company''s next-generation data and analytics ecosystem with a strong focus on Data Democratization, Self-Service, and AI-led innovation. We are seeking a Data Scientist with strong SQL expertise and experience across data engineering, AI, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and Data Science to enable scalable, governed, and intelligent self-service solutions.

The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and supporting advanced analytics, predictive models, intelligent agents, and Generative AI solutions that accelerate business value and operational efficiency.
The ideal candidate combines strong data engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), agent development, and advanced analytics, enabling business users to effectively leverage data and AI capabilities through trusted, self-service platforms and intelligent automation solutions.
Essential Responsibilities

  • Partner with D&A leadership and business stakeholders to evolve and execute the Data Self-Service and Data Democratization strategy.
  • Work directly with functional users to understand self-service data needs across data discovery, reporting, analytics, and advanced use cases.
  • Design, build, and curate high-quality datasets to support analytics and reporting use cases, including development of curation tables.
  • Strong Experience in SQL and PL/SQL
  • Create and maintain data documentation, user guides, and standards in SharePoint to promote adoption and consistent usage.
  • Develop and publish logical and physical data models and ER diagrams to support self-service and semantic layers.
  • Collaborate with architecture and emerging technology teams on proof-of-concept evaluations of new data, analytics, and AI platforms.
  • Help assess whether self-service tools are being used correctly, and guide users toward the most effective tools for their use cases.
  • Contribute to self-service design patterns, implementation standards, and roadmaps based on business usage patterns.
  • Ensure self-service solutions meet enterprise requirements for data quality, metadata, semantic consistency, and performance.
  • Work with security, architecture, and platform teams to ensure data access is governed appropriately for business confidential and sensitive data.
  • Support implementation of new and existing standards, processes, and best practices across data engineering and analytics platforms.
  • Participate in architecture discussions and contribute insights on emerging data technologies, tools, and industry trends.
  • Perform in-depth data analysis, data modeling, and data design activities to support business and analytics needs.
Qualifications/Requirements
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in self-service and analytics platforms including Denodo, Dataiku and Power BI.
  • Hands-on experience with AI platforms (Copilot Studio, AWS Bedrock) for designing and developing intelligent agents and workflow automation
  • Bachelors degree in Information Systems, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field from an accredited institution.
  • Hands-on experience or internships in data engineering, data analytics, data warehousing, or business intelligence.
  • Strong interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts in clear, business-oriented terms.
  • Working knowledge of data engineering and analytics principles, including data modeling, ingestion, transformation, and semantic layer design.
  • Basic exposure to advanced analytics concepts such as predictive analytics, data mining, or statistical analysis is a plus.
  • Understanding data storage and processing technologies including relational databases, columnar databases, Hadoop or Hive-based platforms.
  • Strong Experience in data modeling concepts and tools such as ERwin or ER Studio.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and familiarity with technologies such as Spark, HiveSQL, Python, R, Sqoop, and JDBC or ODBC connectivity.
  • Understanding data visualization best practices and storytelling through dashboards and reports.
Desired Characteristics
  • Experience working on IT or data projects in collaborative, cross-functional teams.
  • Exposure to information systems design, implementation, or operational support.
  • Familiarity with application development or data platform development concepts.
  • Experience or exposure to data technologies such as Hive, Postgres, MySQL, SQL Server, Hadoop, or NoSQL platforms.
  • Experience with metadata management, data cataloging, or data lineage tools is a plus.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms and cloud data strategies is a plus.
  • Strong team player with a collaborative mindset and customer-focused approach.
  • Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills with clear and structured communication.
  • Ability to anticipate challenges and proactively develop mitigation plans.
  • Change-oriented, with a continuous improvement mindset and openness to new ways of working.
  • Self-motivated, resourceful, and able to learn new tools and technologies quickly.

  • High ethical standards and commitment to integrity and accountability.

The AI/ML Engineer is a primary driver in the design and development of state-of-the-art Artificial Intelligence solutions for medical applications. The Principal Data Scientist ML/DL works closely with senior data scientists, machine learning engineers, software engineers and subject matter experts on current company technologies and forward-looking projects. They are the drivers of new research and solution implementation in the creation of novel artificial intelligence approaches.

Primary responsibilities include the enhancement of existing company NLP technologies and extension of those systems in new cloud-based applications. Emphasis is on development of novel machine/deep learning techniques for information extraction and synthesis. They translate research code into clinical NLP solutions deployed at scale in production environments including statistical methods, deep learning, and large language model technologies. Work will involve all aspects of methods development from initial PoC implementation to performance characterization and production launch of new methods.

  • Demonstrated publication record in AI domain especially relating to text extraction and summarization
  • Architect and implement GraphRAG pipelines, including knowledge graph representation and retrieval for enhanced contextual grounding
  • Design, train, and optimize semantic and dense vector embeddings for document understanding, search, and retrieval

  • Experience with PyTorch
  • Experience with Hybrid NLP solutions that combine symbolic and machine learning approaches
  • Deep expertise in: NLP, Fundamental machine learning, deep learning, transformer, state space-based architecture Azure ML and/or AWS
  • Deep knowledge and extensive experience with Machine/Deep Learning frameworks including transformer architectures, state space models, large language models, and agentic approaches
  • Knowledge of algorithms and techniques within a computational domain with emphasis on text processing
  • Solid in Python coding, SQL and database queries, data preparation, and analysis
  • Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)

Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the worlds toughest diseases, and make peoples lives easier, fuller and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains on the cutting-edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond whats known today.
Lets do this. Lets change the world. In this vital role, you will provide strategic and organizational leadership for clinical analytical reporting, data-review technology and data-product capabilities across Global Development.
Building on Sr. Manager accountability for a delivery team, you will lead multiple teams or workstreams, set the multi-year capability and technology roadmap, govern the reporting portfolio and influence enterprise data and digital decisions. You will remain technically credible while operating primarily through leaders, strategic partnerships and portfolio-level decisions.
What you will do
Strategy, operating model and organizational leadership
  • Define and execute the analytical reporting strategy, target operating model and multi-year roadmap for clinical reports, dashboards, visualizations, advanced data-review tools and underlying data products.
  • Lead and develop managers, technical leads and specialist teams; establish role clarity, succession plans, capability-building programs and a culture of quality, innovation, ownership and inclusion.
  • Set portfolio priorities and resource strategy across studies, programs and strategic investments; make transparent trade-offs that optimize patient impact, delivery risk, scalability and enterprise value.
  • Establish governance for intake, architecture, design standards, data definitions, validation, deployment, lifecycle support and retirement of analytical reporting solutions.
Enterprise clinical data-review capability
  • Sponsor integrated, reusable solutions for patient-, study-, program- and portfolio-level data review, including medical and safety dashboards, operational risk indicators, cross-study analytics and review-ready data products.
  • Provide strategic direction for clinical data curation, transformation, semantic models, lineage and accessibility so data can be responsibly reused across analytical solutions.
  • Shape future-state architecture in partnership with Digital Technology, Clinical Systems, Data Architecture, AI & Data, Standards and Statistical Programming teams.
  • Evaluate and sponsor responsible adoption of advanced analytics, anomaly detection, machine learning, generative AI and automation; ensure value hypotheses, validation, privacy, security, traceability and human oversight are built into scaled solutions.
Enterprise influence, transformation and external partnership
  • Represent Analytical Reporting on functional and cross-functional governance bodies and influence senior leaders on clinical data, technology, investment and operating-model decisions.
  • Lead cross-functional transformation programs that modernize clinical data flow, review practices and decision support; translate complex scientific, business and technical needs into executable roadmaps and investment cases.
  • Establish strategic partnerships with Therapeutic Areas, Data Management, Clinical Operations, Medical, Safety, Biostatistics, Quality and Digital Technology to align capability plans with development priorities.
  • Oversee external partner and vendor strategy for assigned scope, including capability assessment, performance governance, quality and appropriate knowledge retention.
Quality, compliance and performance
  • Accountable for a risk-based quality framework that ensures analytical solutions meet applicable ICH-GCP, regulatory, data-integrity, privacy, security, audit-trail and controlled-system expectations.
  • Ensure inspection readiness across the capability and lead responses to material audit, inspection and quality findings.
  • Define outcome, delivery, quality, adoption and maturity metrics; use them to drive enterprise-level continuous improvement and demonstrate value.
What we expect of you
We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The collaborative, technically credible and patient-focused professional we seek has the following qualifications.
Basic qualifications
  • Doctorate degree and 10+ years of relevant experience; OR Masters degree and 13+ years of relevant experience; OR Bachelors degree and 15+ years of relevant experience.
  • 4+ years of managerial or leadership experience, including direct management of people and/or leadership of a substantial technical, functional or cross-functional organization.
  • Demonstrated experience leading clinical reporting, data visualization, clinical analytics, data management, programming, data science or digital-transformation capabilities in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, CRO or closely related regulated settings.
Preferred qualifications
  • Experience defining operating models, strategic roadmaps and governance for enterprise reporting, analytics, data products or clinical-development technology.
  • Deep knowledge of the clinical-development lifecycle, integrated data review, EDC and external data sources, CDISC standards, data architecture, semantic models and data governance.
  • Technical fluency with modern data, analytics and visualization ecosystems, including SQL, Python, R, SAS, cloud data platforms and business-intelligence tools.
  • Track record of leading global transformation, influencing senior executives, developing leaders and delivering measurable improvements at portfolio scale.
  • Experience governing AI-enabled solutions in a regulated environment, including human oversight, validation, explainability, privacy and security.

Amgen is an Equal Opportunity employer and will consider you without regard to your race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability status.

The Research Associate will support the Financial Markets and Policy Project at ICPP, a research programme that bridges market participants, regulators, policymakers and academia through rigorous, neutral and evidence-based work. The role supports research on financial markets, regulation and public policy, contributing to working papers, policy briefs, white papers and case studies. Success in the first six months means producing reliable research support, well-organised data and high-quality inputs for ongoing policy research.

jobDescription:
Inc42 Media is looking for a Content Specialist for the Inc42 BrandLabs team to conceptualise, produce and quality-check native content - across articles, video, and event formats - for startup and enterprise clients, and to help the team consistently meet client deliverables. Through thoughtful, well-reported storytelling, Inc42 aims to remain the platform of record for data-backed news and analysis at the intersection of technology, startups, and business, for a niche audience across Indias startup ecosystem.

About Inc42 Media
Inc42 is India s leading digital media research platform, on a mission to build serve India s tech startup economy.

Founded in January 2015, Inc42 has become the leading source for news analysis on India s rapidly growing internet economy, with over 30,000+ published stories, 50+ research reports, and 100+ conferences events, reaching over 50 Mn+ tech leaders professionals every month.

In 2020, we introduced Inc42 Plus, our membership program designed to help industry leaders professionals stay ahead in India s tech economy with premium tools analysis. With 10,000+ members already, Inc42 Plus is now India s fastest-growing media subscription. Inc42 is recognised cited globally by the likes of Quartz, Forbes, The Economist, The Huffington Post, Business Insider, CBInsights more.

The Inc42 Impact
  • Inc42 stories reach over 50 Mn+ people monthly
  • Published more than 55,000 stories
  • Successfully conducted 150+ events
  • Launched 100+ research reports
  • Receives 500+ startup applications monthly
  • Worked with 350+ brands

Responsibilities

Understanding Translating Client Briefs
  • Understand and analyse client briefs accurately, asking the right clarifying questions upfront to pin down objectives, target audience, tone, etc before content development begins.
  • Translate briefs into clear content outlines and share them internally, seek approval to avoid rework and misalignment later in the cycle.
  • Flag gaps or ambiguities in a brief early, and proactively suggest content angles that better serve the clients stated goals

Content Ideation Writing
  • Conceptualise and develop high-quality company profiles, growth stories, industry articles, and other BrandLabs content formats through thorough primary and secondary research and easily understandable narratives.
  • Build a deep understanding of the Indian startup ecosystem to help BrandLabs clients tailor content strategies and craft narratives aligned with their goals.
  • Contribute to idea generation, story development, and interviews for brand campaigns, ensuring content meets Inc42s editorial standards for writing style, depth, and research.
  • Ideate and create new article formats beyond the existing ones to keep BrandLabs content fresh and suited to different client objectives.
  • Maintain the discipline of native content - never a press release or an advertorial - keeping a neutral, editorial tone while effectively conveying the clients message through storytelling.

Editorial Coordination Quality Checks
  • Coordinate closely with the Editorial team on style, tone, fact-checks, and sign-offs, ensuring BrandLabs content meets the same rigour as Inc42s core editorial output.
  • Run first-level quality checks on all BrandLabs content (articles, scripts, marketing copy) for accuracy, grammar, structure, and brand-safety before it goes out for client or editorial review.
  • Coordinate feedback cycles with clients - collating comments, reconciling conflicting inputs, and ensuring revisions are closed out within timelines.
  • Draft marketing content to support the distribution of client deliverables.

Video Scripting Production Support
  • Assist in scripting video content for BrandLabs campaigns, including explainer videos, interview formats, virtual panel discussions and more.
  • Support video shoots and interviews - including research briefs for anchors/moderators/speakers, question banks, and on-camera coordination - and be comfortable stepping in front of the camera when required.
  • Coordinate with the video/production team on shot lists, timelines, and post-production feedback to ensure the final cut aligns with the clients brief.

Event Support
  • Support BrandLabs event-linked deliverables by assisting with speaker research, briefing documents, and run-of-show content.
  • Assist with pre- and post-event content: promotional copy, recap articles, and social content that extends the shelf life of an event for the client.
  • Provide on-ground/virtual coordination support during curated events and accelerators as needed, liaising between the client, curation, and marketing teams.

Professional Traits
  • Bachelors or Masters degree in Journalism or Mass Communication.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Atleast 3 years of experience in business content writing/production - ideation, scripting, packaging, and more.
  • Well-versed with Google Docs, Google Sheets, WordPress, and SEO.
  • Startup-savvy, with a strong business news sense.
  • Excellent time management skills, able to work seamlessly within deadlines - individually and within teams.
  • Ability to organise, prioritise, and schedule work assignments efficiently.
  • Strong research and analytical skills, with working knowledge of social media content creation and marketing/email communication.

Good to Have
  • Prior experience working with branded content / native advertising setup.
  • An existing network or working familiarity with founders, investors, and operators in the startup ecosystem.
  • Working proficiency in using AI tools for content creation - such as Claude, Meta AI, and others - to speed up research, drafting, and ideation without compromising editorial judgement.
  • Experience conducting video interviews, or confidence and an on-air presence in front of a camera.
  • Desk and rewriting experience for a business publication is an added bonus.
  • Working familiarity with basic video editing workflows to brief editors and give precise post-production feedback.
  • Experience in emceeing live events and keeping the audience engaged.
  • Working knowledge of content performance/analytics tools (Google Analytics, social insights) to gauge whats landing with readers.
  • A genuine urge to be part of the execution team of large scale events like summits, retreats and willingness to take up any role that contributes towards its success in any capacity.

Required Skills
Consistency Content Development Indias Startup Ecosystem Communication article submission video production

As a Senior QA Engineer - Data, you will lead the QA effort for complex data engineering pipelines on Google Cloud Platform. You ll design and implement multi-layered testing strategies-integration, end-to-end, and data quality tests-across tools like dbt, Dataflow, Dataproc, BigQuery, AlloyDB, Cloud SQL, Cloud composer and Cloud Run, etc. Your work ensures the accuracy, reliability, and performance of data systems at scale.

Testing Strategy Test Design
- Define and maintain testing methodologies for the full GCP data engineering stack: Dataflow (TestPipeline), Dataproc (spark-testing-base or pytest), Cloud Run container tests, and SQL-based data validation in BigQuery/dbt.

Pipeline Database Testing

- Use emulators or dedicated test instances to test Spanner, Cloud SQL, and AlloyDB. Validate stored procedures and database functions with sample data.
End-to-End (E2E) Pipeline Validation
- Orchestrate comprehensive E2E tests via Cloud Composer/Apache Airflow or scripting. Simulate real-world data flows and validate intermediate and final outputs.
CI/CD Automation
- Embed QA in CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions), automating test execution at all levels including data quality validations and dbt runs.
- Use IaC tools (Terraform, Deployment Manager) to provision reproducible test environments.
Collaboration Stakeholder Engagement
- Partner with data engineers and stakeholders to review design for testability.
- Mentor junior QA team members, champion QA best practices, and lead efforts to improve data quality KPIs and test effectiveness.
Monitoring Observability
- Utilize Cloud Logging, Monitoring, and observability tools (e.g., Elementary Data) to track pipeline health, test results, and identify anomalies.

Required Qualifications
- 5+ years in QA or software testing, including focused on data pipelines/data warehouses
- Proficient in complex SQL and writing data validation queries.
- Strong experience with GCP data tools: dbt, BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataproc, Cloud Run, Spanner, AlloyDB, Cloud SQL.
- Hands-on with data-quality frameworks: Great Expectations, Soda Core, dbt-utils, dbt-expectations.
- Familiarity with database emulators and test environment provisioning.
- CI/CD automation experience (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions).
- Skilled in scripting languages (Python, pytest).
- Excellent communication, mentoring ability, critical thinking, and attention to detail.
- API testing with PI Testing Postman REST APIs

Preferred Qualifications
- GCP Professional Data Engineer certification
- Experience enhancing dbt tests with dbt-utils and dbt-expectations.
- Knowledge of BigQuery data-quality services like Dataplex.
- Proficient with observability tooling (Cloud Logging, Elementary Data).
- Familiarity with data governance, lineage, and compliance validation.
- Exposure enterprise-based data migration project
- Exposure to Datawarehouse modernization

Job Summary

This is a growth role with a number attached to it.

You will run acquisition campaigns end to end - plan the budget, pick the channels and creators, ship the campaigns, read the data, and reallocate spend toward whatever is working. Youll own CPL, CAC and conversations for the programs assigned to you, and youll be expected to explain movement in those numbers without being asked twice.

You should have a working network of agencies, creators and talent managers you can pick up the phone and activate.

Over the next 6-12 months, this role will grow into managing a team of 2-3 people.

If your instinct on a dashboard is to look for the story behind the drop rather than the drop itself, youll do well here.

Key Responsibilities

1. Performance Marketing

  • Assist the performance marketing team with sourcing UGC creatives, influencer videos, and track paid acquisition campaigns across Meta, Google, YouTube and other performance channels.
  • Own creative budget allocation and pacing across programs - decide where the next rupee goes and be able to defend the decision.
  • Drive down CPL and CAC while protecting lead quality - volume at the cost of quality is not a win here.
  • Work closely with the content and design teams on creative briefs, iterations and refresh cycles.

2. Influencer Creator-Led Growth

  • Identify, evaluate and onboard creators across niches, tiers and languages, matching creator audience to program fit.
  • Negotiate commercials, deliverables, timelines and usage/ad rights; manage the relationship through the full campaign cycle.
  • Work with the content team on briefs and scripts, and hold the quality bar on what goes live.
  • Track creator performance down to the individual creative - views, clicks, leads, bookings, cost per booking - and build a tiering view of who to scale, who to retain, and who to retire.
  • Repurpose high-performing creator content into paid creatives to extend the life and reach of every activation.

3. Data, Analytics Decision-Making

  • Build and maintain reporting on campaign and channel performance.
  • Analyse the full funnel impressions and identify exactly where drop-off is happening and why.
  • Use GA4, Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads and Excel/Google Sheets to pull your own data.
  • Turn analysis into decisions: budget shifts, channel pivots, narrative changes, funnel fixes. Insight that doesnt change an action isnt useful to us.
  • Report performance to leadership with a clear point of view

4. New Channels Growth Experiments

  • Identify and test new acquisition channels and growth levers beyond the current mix.
  • Design experiments with a clear hypothesis, budget cap and success metric; document what you learn either way.
  • Spot market saturation and channel fatigue early, and lead the pivot before performance falls off.

5. Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Content, Design, Product, Admissions and Counselling to keep the message consistent from ad to landing page to counselling call.

6. Team Leadership

Senior Product Manager - ADI Platform Developer Experience

Hyderabad, India

Hybrid

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the ADI Platform the technical and product foundation on which every ADI squad builds. ADI is a micro front-end (MFE) architecture: a common shell (authentication, navigation, notifications, search, component library, home and admin pages) into which independent squads Investor, Payments, Fund of Funds, Reporting and others plug their surfaces. Without a well-owned, well-governed platform layer, those surfaces fragment, degrade, and slow down. This role exists to prevent that.

You are not building features for end users directly you are building the product that enables every other product team. Your customers are internal squads and their engineers, and your success is measured by their velocity, consistency, and ability to ship. At the same time, you own capabilities that are end-user facing and mission-critical: authentication and access control, the home experience, notifications, universal search, and the shared component library. You must hold the platform to the same rigour as any customer-facing product with performance, availability, security and developer experience treated as first-class requirements.

You will work hands-on: authoring executable PRDs, building the first prototypes yourself, and partnering tightly with engineering, architecture, and the other product managers across the ADI programme.

Your Responsibilities

  • Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for the ADI Platform the MFE shell, authentication and authorisation layer, shared component library, notifications engine, universal search, and all cross-cutting platform capabilities.
  • Define and maintain a clear boundary between what the Platform owns and what belongs to feature squads resolving ambiguity at pace and with authority, so no squad is ever blocked by an unclear ownership question.
  • Prioritise the platform backlog against squad-enablement velocity, non-functional requirements, technical debt, and programme-level delivery commitments.
  • Act as the product authority for the platform, making the decisions that trade off between feature-squad needs and platform coherence.
  • Treat the other ADI squads as your primary customers understand their dependency needs, pain points and roadmap commitments, and design the platform to enable them rather than constrain them.
  • Own the golden-path developer experience: template projects, the shared NPM component library (Photon), CI/CD patterns, MFE composition standards, and deployment infrastructure ensuring every squad has a well-lit path to building and shipping.
  • Establish and govern the standards and contracts between the platform and squad microsites import maps, API standards, component versioning, and token enrichment so the platform can evolve without breaking consumers.
  • Work alongside the other product managers to help their teams onboard to, and correctly consume, platform capabilities.
  • Own the end-to-end authentication and authorisation product: integration with CIAM and GSP, role-based access control (RBAC), UI component-level authorisation patterns, token enrichment, and the multi-tenancy and client-isolation model.
  • Define the access model clearly who can see what, in which context, for which client or fund and ensure it is implemented consistently across every squad s surface.
  • Own org context switching, user account management (/account), and the admin experience (/admin).
  • Own the ADI home page including the customisable widget framework (calendar views, user-based preferences) and ensure it serves as a coherent, high-value landing experience for all user personas.
  • Own universal search across ADI defining scope, relevance, and the integration model with squad-specific content in alignment with the AI-unified search strategy.
  • Own the notifications engine defining the notification taxonomy, routing logic, SLA and priority model, and the interfaces through which feature squads publish notifications and partner with the squads (e.g. Fund of Funds, Payments) who consume it.
  • Own the cross-team calendar service, the feature-flagging framework, and user-analytics instrumentation.
  • Own platform-level non-functional requirements performance, availability, scalability, security (including penetration testing), accessibility and observability as first-class product requirements, not afterthoughts.
  • Define the platform s SLAs and the squad contracts that rely on them; ensure monitoring, logging, error handling, alerting and rollback capability are production-grade from day one.
  • Own the global and regional deployment and caching strategy, and the CI/CD framework that all squads depend on.
  • Author Executable PRDs (xPRDs) structured context repositories that combine natural-language intent, machine-actionable specification, complete business and technical context, edge cases, success metrics and acceptance criteria, and embedded governance guardrails.
  • Build the first functional prototype yourself during ideation and discovery, using AI tooling to validate desirability (product-market fit with clients) and feasibility (with architects) in parallel then hand a high-fidelity, context-rich prototype to engineering to curate and take to production quality.

Job Summary

Client is an AI-first clean energy company that builds and operates solar and battery storage assets for industrial customers. They work across long-term power purchase agreements, group captive structures and dedicated project SPVs, financed through a mix of equity and project debt. That structure is what makes finance here unusual. Every project is a company in its own right, with its own capital structure, lenders, co-investors and compliance obligations. Finance sits close to the deal rather than downstream of it. Incorporated in May 2025, Company has multiple PPAs with 10+ companies including listed companies, and a growing captive order book, totaling to about 50+ MW. Client is backed by institutional capital. They are still early-stage. Processes are being built as they grow and you will be instrumental in building them.

You will help build and run the finance backbone of Kind Energy and its portfolio of project entities. The work falls into three areas.

01 Finance Compliance

You will own the financial and statutory compliance framework across the parent company and every project SPV:

  • Accounting, financial reporting and the monthly close
  • GST, TDS and income tax compliance
  • ROC/MCA and Companies Act compliance across multiple SPVs and LLPs (with the help of our CS)
  • Statutory audits and coordination with external advisors
  • Financial controls, MIS and internal reporting discipline

The first goal is a clean, consistent view across every entity.

The second is to build the systems, templates and team that keep it that way as we scale. We are not hiring someone to run compliance manually forever.

02 Fund Flow Treasury

Renewable projects are capital-intensive, and execution depends on money reaching the right entity at the right time. You will manage:

  • Capex drawdowns and lender disbursements
  • Vendor payment processes and working capital requirements
  • Equity infusion schedules across SPVs
  • Debt covenants, reserve accounts and project-level obligations
  • Inter-company and SPV fund flows
  • Cash-flow planning across the EPC and IPP businesses

You will work closely with the founders and project teams so that financial planning supports execution on the ground.

03 Structuring Transactions

This is where the role extends well beyond finance operations. You will work on:

  • Financial Modelling, capital structuring and shareholding designing for new project SPVs
  • Equity structuring across Kind, captive users and co-investors
  • Cap table and dilution modelling through the fundraise
  • Term sheets and transaction documentation, alongside our legal advisors
  • Investor and lender due diligence
  • Project finance processes and lender coordination

You are not expected to know all of this on day one. You are expected to want to understand why a structure is being used, not only how it should be accounted for.

You will work across operating finance, project finance, SPV structuring and transactions, often in the same week. Very few roles at this stage of a career cover that range.

You will work directly with the founders, with regular exposure to investors, lenders, NBFCs, advisors and counterparties.

Open access, group captive and storage economics in India are being rewritten right now. It is a genuinely useful thing to understand early.

As the finance function grows, this seat is meant to grow into leading it.

Requirements

Must have

  • Qualified Chartered Accountant with 3+ years of post-qualification experience
  • Strong command of GST, TDS, income tax and Companies Act compliance
  • Experience across multiple entities or reasonably complex financial structures
  • Strong Excel and financial modelling skills
  • Ownership and follow-through without reminders
  • Comfort working in a growing organisation where processes are still being formed

Nice to have

  • Infrastructure, renewable energy, real estate, NBFC or project finance exposure
  • Any exposure to fundraising, debt financing or financial due diligence
  • Statutory audit or transaction advisory background from a mid-size or large firm
  • Interest in using technology and automation to improve how finance runs

Your first few months

  • Month 1. A clear picture of every group entity- books, filings, banking, open items. You tell us what is broken.
  • Months 2-3. A standardised monthly close and reporting pack across all entities, and a structured payment and fund-flow process.
  • From there. You take a real piece of a live transaction, i.e. a new SPV, a lender sanction or an investor due diligence.

This role may not be right for you if

  • You are looking for a narrowly defined role with well-established processes
  • You prefer a predictable scope of work that rarely changes
  • You are uncomfortable taking ownership before every answer is fully defined
  • You would rather stay exclusively within compliance and accounting

Location

Requirements

descriptionFromApi:
Role Overview

As a Senior Data Scientist in Merchandising, you will help build and improve data science ML and Optimization models that power Target's Planogram capabilities. The primary focus of this role will be Sales Forecasting and elasticity models with optimization-based presentation recommendations. You will partner with Data Scientists, Product Managers, Engineers, Analysts, Merchandising partners, and business stakeholders to translate complex problems into scalable modelling solutions. This role is ideal for someone with strong foundations in machine learning, statistical modeling, forecasting, and applied optimization, with interest in solving high-impact retail problems at scale. Experience with Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, or AI agents is a plus as the team explores AI-enabled measurement, explainability, monitoring, and decision-support workflows.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, validate, and improve forecasting and elasticity models (using Regressions) that estimate Sales which is used as input for facings recommendations on Planogram.
  • Account for multiple variables present in forecasting and separate impact of target variable on Sales (VIF, multicollinearity).
  • Use optimization to recommend optimal item placements on POG such that expense to service POG's is lower and all item facings which are recommended fit on the POG (constrained Linear programming including the use of Fuzzy logic constraints).
  • Create Item groups/segments to measure POG Performance and recommend changes using segmentation and similarity measures.
  • Scale and deploy solution to production environments.
  • Create measurement frameworks to evaluate model performance.
  • Partner with business and product teams to understand strategy, define success metrics, and translate requirements into model design.
  • Work with large-scale retail data including sales, presentation history, item attributes, inventory, store and market attributes, and guest demand signals.
  • Conduct deep-dive analyses to diagnose model performance, elasticity behavior, underperforming recommendations, outliers, sparse data, and category-specific pricing patterns.
  • Support experimentation and measurement design, including A/B tests, market tests, incrementality measurement, control/test methodology, and model impact assessment.
  • Collaborate with ML Engineers and Software Engineers to productionize models, automate pipelines, improve reliability, and integrate outputs into business-facing workflows.
  • Monitor model performance over time, identify drift or degradation, and recommend improvements to maintain model quality and business impact.
  • Communicate model logic, assumptions, trade-offs, risks, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Contribute to model explainability and adoption by helping business partners understand why recommendations are generated.
  • Explore GenAI, LLMs, RAG, and agents for pricing use cases such as explainability, measurement automation, performance monitoring, and recommendation efficiency.

About You

  • Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Operations Research, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
  • 4+ years of relevant experience in data science, applied machine learning, forecasting, optimization, retail domain knowledge, GCP, Big Data.
  • Strong hands-on experience building and validating machine learning or statistical models in a business setting.
  • Experience within Merchandising on elasticity modeling, demand modeling and forecasting.
  • Strong understanding of statistical concepts, model evaluation, feature engineering, regularization, cross-validation, uncertainty, and model interpretability.
  • Experience with optimization such as constrained optimization, linear programming, mixed-integer programming.
  • Experience with experimentation and measurement.
  • Ability to work on Big Data.
  • Ability to scale solutions to production environments.
  • Strong programming skills in Python and SQL, with experience working on large datasets using Spark, PySpark, Hive, Hadoop, or similar platforms.
  • Ability to analyze complex data, diagnose model issues, and convert findings into actionable recommendations.
  • Ability to work in ambiguous problem spaces, structure analytical approaches, and deliver high-quality outcomes against business timelines.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to partner across Data Science, Product, Engineering, Analytics, Merchandising, and business teams.

Must-Have Skills

  • Python
  • SQL
  • Machine Learning
  • Forecasting
  • Elasticity Modelling
  • Optimization
  • Spark
  • PySpark
  • Hive

Engineer

Job type: Full Time

Department: Engineering

Work type: On-Site

Chennai; Bengaluru

Charles Proteus Steinmetz was once called in to solve a problem with a massive electrical generator that no one else could fix.

After studying the machine, he made a small chalk mark indicating exactly where the engineers needed to make the repair.

His bill

for making the chalk mark.
for knowing where to put it.

We re looking for that kind of engineer.

We call this role The Engineer.

Not because the problems are small, but because the best engineers have an unusual ability to cut through complexity, identify the one thing that matters, and solve problems others struggle with for weeks.

At Kula, you ll work on some of our hardest problems across AI and agentic systems. You ll build intelligent systems that dont just assist humans, but reason, take action, and autonomously complete meaningful work.

This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who combines exceptional technical judgment with extreme execution speed.

What youll do

You ll build AI systems and agents that operate in the real world.

You ll take ambitious, ambiguous problems and turn them into working products - fast.

You ll experiment with LLMs, agents, tools, memory, reasoning, evaluation, and orchestration to push the boundaries of what autonomous systems can reliably do.

You ll own problems end-to-end: understanding the problem, designing the system, writing the code, shipping it, observing how it behaves, and improving it.

You ll know when a problem needs a sophisticated new architecture and when it needs a chalk mark.

You might be the Engineer if...

You have an unusual ability to find the root cause of complex problems.

You can take something from an idea to production faster than most teams can schedule the kickoff meeting.

You have strong opinions, but youre willing to throw them away when the data proves you wrong.

You dont measure your impact by lines of code or hours spent. You measure it by problems solved.

You are deeply curious about AI and agentic systems and are constantly building, experimenting, and learning.

You thrive in ambiguity. Give you a well-defined ticket and youll execute it. Give you a seemingly impossible problem and youll come alive.

You care deeply about craft but you understand that speed is a feature.

The bar

Were not looking for someone who simply knows how to call an LLM API.

Were looking for someone who understands how to turn rapidly evolving AI capabilities into reliable products that people can trust.

Someone who can move from first principles to prototype to production at exceptional speed.

Someone who can look at a problem everyone else thinks is complicated, make the right chalk mark, and say: "Fix it here."

If that sounds like you, wed love to meet you.

This is a digital-first HNI client role built around high-quality conversations, not mass outreach. You will engage qualified, high-intent prospects with 50 lakh+ portfolios, identify where their investments can work harder, and guide suitable clients into 0.1% Club s Managed Portfolios.

Portfolio first. Client always.

Job Summary

Title: Technical Program Manager, AI Benchmarking

Location: New Delhi, India

Work Authorization: Current and ongoing work authorization in India

Position: Full-time

Role Overview

PxD is looking for a Technical Program Manager to lead delivery of a national initiative benchmarking Indian AI models for agricultural advisory. Government advisory platforms are increasingly powered by large language models, and a growing set of Indian foundational models, fine-tuned variants, and voice-based systems have emerged as potential alternatives - but little rigorous evidence exists on how they perform inside live advisory workflows. You will run a multi-partner benchmarking program that produces decision-ready evidence for the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare on which models can be safely and effectively integrated into existing advisory systems.

PxD will co-design the benchmark framework and act as consortium facilitator and government coordination partner for this work, convening government agencies, academic technical evaluators, benchmark partners, and model providers. You will be the person who holds that consortium together day to day: setting the benchmarking architecture with government, contracting and managing academic and technical partners, overseeing the evidence pipeline from technical testing through farmer-facing user research, and turning the results into recommendations a ministry can act on. This position is based in New Delhi, with travel to partner institutions and project states.

What You'll Bring

Required

  • Masters degree (or equivalent experience) in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Public Policy, Economics, Agriculture, Development Studies, Management, or another relevant field.
  • 5-8 years of progressively responsible experience managing complex technical programs or projects.
  • Working fluency with modern AI systems - LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation, prompting, model evaluation, and the practical trade-offs between accuracy, latency, safety, and cost.
  • Demonstrated experience managing multi-stakeholder projects involving government agencies, academic institutions, and external technical partners.
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to run parallel workstreams against fixed donor milestones.
  • Ability to translate technical evidence into clear, decision-oriented recommendations for non-technical senior audiences.
  • Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building abilities.

Responsibilities

Government Stakeholder Management

  • Serve as PxD's day-to-day point of contact for the benchmarking program, working through PxD's embedded PMU team to align the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare on priority use cases, target languages and geographies, candidate models, benchmarking baselines, and approval pathways.
  • Establish the governance framework for the consortium - partner roles, decision rights, steering cadence, and escalation routes - and keep it functioning as the program moves through its stages.
  • Negotiate system and data access, including access to government advisory environments for substitution testing, and maintain a permissions tracker across government, academic, and advisory data sources.
  • Facilitate workshops and consultations with government counterparts, model providers, and domain experts; manage the funder relationship and reporting.

Benchmarking Design Technical Delivery

  • Own the benchmarking framework end to end: advisory use cases, benchmark tasks, datasets, human-rating rubrics, safety and language criteria, tool-use and source-grounding assessments, cost comparison templates, and decision thresholds.
  • Work with existing benchmark initiatives to adapt and localise established assets rather than building a parallel benchmark.
  • Coordinate technical benchmarking across three layers - standalone model evaluation, substitution testing within the live government advisory stack, and a neutral benchmarking harness where direct system access is unavailable - alongside assessment of speech recognition, translation, text-to-speech, and multilingual performance.
  • Manage latency, reliability, and total-cost-of-ownership analysis, and oversee the cloud compute, GPU, and API resources that represent the single largest cost line in the program.
  • Safeguard the independence and neutrality of the benchmarking by maintaining clear separation between benchmark development, model evaluation, and model development roles of partner organisations, with transparent disclosure of potential conflicts of interest.

Evidence Generation Synthesis

  • Oversee pre-deployment user evidence generation with agronomists, extension personnel, and compensated farmer participant testers, assessing whether advisory outputs are comprehensible, actionable, trustworthy, and usable in local languages.
  • Manage IRB submission and third-party field vendor selection and oversight for user testing.
  • Consolidate findings across technical performance, user evidence, safety, operational readiness, and cost into a single decision framework, and translate them into recommendations a non-technical government audience can act on.
  • Author the final evidence synthesis and decision report identifying models ready for pilot deployment, models requiring further optimization, and key implementation risks.

We are looking for an experienced Java Developer with strong expertise in backend development, cloud technologies, and emerging AI-powered automation. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Core Development

  1. Design, develop, and maintain robust backend applications using Java, Spring Boot, and Hibernate
  2. Build and integrate RESTful APIs and event-driven services for seamless communication between microservices and AI agents
  3. Deploy and manage applications on AWS Cloud infrastructure
  4. Ensure code quality, performance optimization, and adherence to best practices

Agentic AI & Generative AI

  1. Design and implement AI agent workflows building autonomous agents that can plan, execute multi step tasks, invoke tools, and handle exceptions without constant human oversight
  2. Develop agent orchestration patterns — manage agent-to-agent handovers, state persistence, retry logic, and fallback strategies in multi-agent systems
  3. Integrate with foundation model APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, or equivalent) for LLM-powered reasoning, decision-making, and natural language understanding within agent pipelines
  4. Build tool-use and function-calling interfaces that allow AI agents to interact with databases, APIs, document stores, and external services
  5. Implement human-in-the-loop patterns — confidence thresholds, escalation triggers, and approval workflows where agents defer to humans on low-confidence decisions
  6. Develop event-driven agent architectures using message queues (SQS/SNS, EventBridge, or Kafka) for async agent communication and workflow orchestration

Collaboration & Quality

  1. Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, data science, QA) to deliver high-quality AI-powered solutions
  2. Participate in prompt engineering, agent behavior tuning, and accuracy evaluation
  3. Contribute to AI-assisted development workflows using tools like Kiro, Copilot, or similar AI IDEs

REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

Experience - 2–8 years of professional experience in backend/fullstack development

Core Backend - Strong proficiency in Java (11+), Spring Boot, and Hibernate/JPA

APIs - Hands-on experience designing and integrating RESTful APIs and webhook based integrations

Cloud (AWS) - Working knowledge of AWS services — EC2, S3, Lambda, SQS/SNS, EventBridge, API Gateway, Cognito

Agentic AI - Experience building or integrating with autonomous AI agent systems — multi step workflows, tool-use patterns, agent orchestration, state management

Generative AI - Hands-on experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) — prompt engineering, function calling, structured output parsing

Databases - Proficiency with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) — schema design, query optimization

Architecture - Understanding of event-driven and microservices architecture patterns

Problem-Solving - Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills

GOOD TO HAVE

AGENTIC AI & ADVANCED AI

  1. Experience with AI agent frameworks (AWS AgentCore, LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or custom agent orchestrators)
  2. Familiarity with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) patterns — vector databases, embeddings, document retrieval
  3. Experience with confidence scoring, human-in-the-loop decision systems, and AI output validation
  4. Exposure to multi-agent systems where multiple specialized agents collaborate on complex workflows
  5. Experience building AI agents that interact with external APIs, document processing services, or third party platforms via tool-use/function-calling
  6. Familiarity with prompt management, A/B testing prompts, and agent behavior evaluation

PLATFORM & DEVOPS

  1. Experience with Microservices Architecture at scale
  2. Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins) and Docker/Kubernetes
  3. Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, AWS CDK)
  4. Experience with Amazon ECS/EKS for container orchestration
  5. Familiarity with observability tools (CloudWatch, X-Ray, Grafana) for monitoring agent pipelines

DEVELOPMENT PRACTICES

  1. Exposure to Agile methodologies
  2. Experience with AI-assisted development tools (Kiro, GitHub Copilot, or similar)
  3. Understanding of async processing patterns (event sourcing, CQRS, saga patterns)
  4. Experience with document processing or OCR integration (Textract, Ocrolus, or similar)

WHAT SETS THIS ROLE APART

This is not a traditional backend role. You'll be building systems where AI agents are first-class participants in business workflows — making decisions, invoking services, handling exceptions, and coordinating with other agents autonomously.

You'll need to think about:

  1. How agents maintain context and state across multi-step operations
  2. How to design reliable failover when an agent encounters an unexpected scenario
  3. How to balance autonomy (letting agents act) vs. control (humans approving)
  4. How to test and validate non-deterministic AI agent behavior in production systems

AGENTIC AI SKILLS SPECTRUM

LEVEL & WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

Minimum - Has integrated LLM APIs into applications, understands prompt engineering, built at least one multi-step automated workflow using AI

Preferred - Has designed agent orchestration patterns, built tool-calling interfaces, implemented human-in-the-loop escalation, worked with agent frameworks

Ideal - Has architected multi-agent systems in production, designed agent state management, built agent observability/evaluation, managed agent reliability in production

jobDescription:
ABOUT GLOBALSIGN

Established in 1996, GlobalSign is the leading provider of trusted identity and security solutions enabling businesses, large enterprises, cloud service providers and IoT innovators around the world to secure online

communications, manage millions of verified digital identities and automate digital signing, authentication, and encryption. Its high- scale PKI solutions support the billions of services, devices, people, and things comprising the Internet of Everything (IoE). The company has offices in the Americas, Europe, and Asia.


JOB SUMMARY:

The AI Enablement Lead is responsible for accelerating the adoption and valorisation of artificial intelligence (AI) across GlobalSign. Working within the IT Department and reporting to the Chief Information and Security Officer, this role owns AI governance and policy, evaluates and rationalizes the AI tool portfolio, prepares the organization's knowledge and data for AI use, leads AI-driven business process transformation, measures the value delivered, and develops AI capability across the workforce. The AI Enablement Lead is the primary internal catalyst for AI-driven transformation, from strategy and tooling through to hands-on delivery support .


Role & responsibilities

1. Drive AI Governance and Policy Optimization

  • Own and continuously optimize GlobalSign's AI usage policy, acceptable-use standards, and approval workflows, keeping them practical enough to encourage adoption while protecting the company's position as a publicly trusted certificate authority.
  • Define and govern the AI operating model: platform selection, data usage, security-by-design, model lifecycle management, and integration with existing IT architecture.
  • Set human-in-the-loop, review, and disclosure requirements for AI outputs used in regulated, audited, or customer-facing processes, and refresh policy as tool capabilities change.

2. Evaluate Emerging AI Technologies and Optimize the Tool Portfolio

  • Scan the market for emerging AI models, agents, copilots, and platforms, and run structured evaluations against capability, total cost, security posture, data residency, and integration fit.
  • Rationalize the tool portfolio by consolidating overlapping tools and retiring those underused or superseded and support procurement and legal review of AI vendors.
  • Maintain reusable frameworks and reference architectures so departments build on a consistent foundation and advise leadership on build-versus-buy and investment priorities.

3. Establish AI-Ready Knowledge and Data Management Practices

  • Define how enterprise knowledge is structured, labelled, owned, and maintained so that it can be reliably retrieved and used by AI systems.
  • Lead the design of retrieval-augmented generation foundations: source-of-truth repositories, indexing strategy, access controls, and rules for content freshness and ownership.
  • Set data classification and handling rules governing which data may reach which AI systems and improve data quality in the systems feeding AI use cases.

4. Manage AI Adoption Metrics and Subscription Inventory

  • Maintain a complete inventory of AI tools, agents, models, and subscriptions, including business owner, cost, contract terms, renewal dates, and governance status.
  • Track license utilization and adoption by department and users, identifying under-used seats, unmet demand, and unsanctioned shadow AI.
  • Drive cost optimization through rightsizing, consolidation, and timely renewal or cancellation decisions.

5. Lead AI-Driven Business Process Transformation

  • Map existing processes with department leads, identify automation and augmentation opportunities, and prioritize them by value, feasibility, and risk.
  • Redesign workflows around AI capabilities rather than layering tools onto unchanged processes, translating business problems into scoped use cases with named owners.
  • Move teams from proof-of-concept to production deployment, providing hands-on delivery support and coordinating across departments to avoid duplication.

6. Measure, Track, and Report Business Impact

  • Define AI value KPIs covering adoption, efficiency gains, cost, quality, risk reduction, and customer impact, and establish baselines before deployment.
  • Build and maintain a central AI value dashboard showing active initiatives, their status, and their measured outcomes.
  • Report to leadership and the Board on realized versus projected value, and recommend whether initiatives are scaled, sustained, or stopped.

REQUIRED SKILLS:

  • 5+ years of relevant professional experience
  • Demonstrable experience in AI, data, technology consulting, or IT strategy role, with hands-on delivery of AI or automation projects at organizational level.
  • Strong understanding of modern AI concepts including large language models, AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation, and copilot architectures.
  • Proven ability to define, track, and communicate value metrics and KPIs related to technology adoption and business impact.
  • Experience establishing knowledge management, documentation, or data governance standards, and managing a software or SaaS portfolio including licenses, cost, and renewals .

Role Summary

As the AI Operations Incident Commander (Offshore), you will lead live incident coordination during offshore hours and provide structured command for production issues impacting the clients AI support environment. We need someone who can rapidly size the situation, confirm severity, engage the right teams, keep the bridge disciplined, and maintain an accurate view of what is happening technically. This role sits close to the work: you should be comfortable coordinating engineers, reviewing evidence, challenging weak updates, and preparing clean handoffs to the onshore lead and client stakeholders when needed.

Key Responsibilities

1. Live incident command and technical coordination

  • Lead Severity 1, Severity 2, and priority production incidents during offshore coverage, including bridge setup, severity confirmation, responder coordination, action tracking, and restoration cadence.
  • Drive structured technical triage across SRE, platform, integration, application, service desk, security, and vendor teams so incidents continue moving and do not stall in ambiguity.
  • Maintain a current command view of symptoms, likely causes, actions in progress, risks, dependencies, and next decisions required.

2. Handoffs, escalation, and operational discipline

  • Prepare concise, high-quality handoffs to the onshore lead with clear incident status, unresolved risks, owners, timestamps, and recommended next actions.
  • Escalate early when severity, business impact, stakeholder sensitivity, or technical uncertainty requires broader engagement or onshore leadership attention.
  • Ensure ticket hygiene, bridge notes, timelines, and action logs are complete enough to support RCA, reporting, and clean follow-through.

3. Change risk, problem management, and improvement support

  • Support operational readiness for risky changes, releases, and maintenance activities by asking the right questions about rollback, validation, monitoring, and support readiness.
  • Contribute incident evidence and technical observations into post-incident reviews and corrective-action planning.
  • Identify repeat failure patterns, weak runbooks, and support-process gaps, then push improvements back into the service.

4. Stakeholder engagement and team ways of working

  • Work closely with the onshore incident lead, offshore engineers, resolver groups, vendors, and service leadership to keep decision-making and recovery aligned.
  • Engage stakeholders proactively to unblock work rather than waiting for direction when an incident is already live.
  • Create structure in fast-moving situations and help less experienced responders operate with clarity and confidence.

Preferred Skills and Experience


Major incident leadership

Experience coordinating high-severity production incidents, including bridge management, severity assessment, action tracking, and restoration management.

Technical support depth

Enough technical depth to follow cloud, application, integration, and observability signals and challenge incomplete or weak technical updates.

Service operations and ITIL

Experience working within ITIL-aligned incident, problem, change, and service-request processes with strong ticket hygiene.

Communication and handoffs

Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to provide concise bridge updates and high-quality handoffs across shifts.

Problem solving under ambiguity

Ability to make sound decisions with incomplete information, prioritize quickly, and keep progress moving.

Ownership and teamwork

Strong sense of ownership, comfort operating in ambiguity, and willingness to engage stakeholders proactively to unblock work.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in cloud platform support, AI platform support, complex enterprise application support, or NOC / command-center style operations.
  • Experience coordinating high-priority incidents in an ITIL-aligned environment with strong documentation discipline.
  • Familiarity with ServiceNow, bridge tooling, service reporting, shift handoffs, and working in a managed-services model.
  • Comfort working across offshore and onshore support teams with shared ownership and tight communication loops.

Working Style & Core Behaviors

  • Stays calm and methodical when incidents are noisy, urgent, or under-defined.
  • Knows how to separate signal from noise and keep the bridge focused on the next best action.
  • Works well with engineers, service desk teams, vendors, and leadership without waiting for perfect direction.
  • Pushes for clarity, evidence, and ownership while still being collaborative and pragmatic.
  • Treats clean handoffs and documentation as part of the job, not admin work.

What Good Looks Like

  • Can take control of a live incident quickly and make it obvious what the team is doing and why.
  • Keeps technical responders focused, escalates at the right time, and does not let issues drift.
  • Hands off incidents cleanly to onshore leadership without losing context or forcing rework.
  • Turns repeated failure patterns into better runbooks, monitoring, and support discipline.

Team Context

You will join PwCs AI Operations & Platform Support team supporting clients run-state AI environment. The operating model is centered on Level 2 and Level 3 support, monitoring, incident response, service requests, minor enhancements, and continuous improvement across AWS/Bedrock, OpenAI, and related platform components.

This role will work in a managed-services model focused on incident management, service requests, monitoring, minor enhancements, knowledge management, and continuous improvement. Success depends not only on technical skill, but also on ownership, collaboration, and the ability to engage stakeholders to progress work.

title: AI Developer
jobDescription:
Role Summary

This role is for an AI Developer who will help accelerate the Promo Price Optimization team's adoption of Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and Agentic AI capabilities within the PARROT platform. This individual will work hands-on with the PARROT engineering and product teams to identify, design, build, and deploy practical AI use cases that improve the promotional planning experience and create measurable value for users.

A key part of the role will be to build capability within the existing team, helping developers develop the skills and engineering practices required to confidently build and maintain AI-enabled solutions themselves. The AI Developer will also act as a technical bridge between the team and client's enterprise AI Platform, ensuring PARROT's AI solutions align with the platform's capabilities, standards, and recommended implementation patterns.

PARROT is an existing cloud-native application built around independently deployed services, APIs, event-driven processing, and GCP technologies, providing a strong foundation for introducing AI capabilities into existing product workflows.

Core Responsibilities & Experience

  • Partner with product and engineering teams to identify, evaluate, prioritize, and deliver LLM and Agentic AI use cases within PARROT.
  • Design, prototype, build, test, and deploy production-ready AI capabilities, moving use cases from experimentation through integration into the PARROT application.
  • Provide hands-on technical leadership throughout the AI development lifecycle, including solution design, model and platform integration, evaluation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and ongoing improvement.
  • Act as a technical liaison between the PARROT team and the AEGIS AI Platform, helping the team understand and adopt available platform capabilities rather than developing unnecessary PARROT-specific AI infrastructure.
  • Establish reusable patterns and reference implementations for integrating LLM and Agentic AI capabilities into PARROT's existing services and workflows.
  • Upskill PARROT developers through pairing, code reviews, technical workshops, documentation, examples, and hands-on development so that AI capabilities can increasingly be owned and maintained by the core team.
  • Establish practical engineering practices for AI development, including prompt management, structured outputs, tool use, agent orchestration, evaluation, observability, error handling, and testing.
  • Evaluate technical tradeoffs between traditional software solutions, deterministic automation, LLM-based solutions, and agentic approaches, applying AI only where it provides meaningful product or engineering value.
  • Collaborate with product, engineering, analytics, architecture, and AI Platform teams to ensure AI solutions meet business requirements while remaining scalable, maintainable, secure, and supportable.
  • Requires strong industry experience building production software, with demonstrated hands-on experience developing and deploying applications using LLMs, Generative AI, or Agentic AI technologies.

Technical Skills

  • Software Development: Strong proficiency in Python and experience developing production-grade back-end applications and APIs. Experience with SQL and modern software engineering practices is required.
  • Generative AI & LLMs: Strong hands-on industry experience integrating LLMs into production applications, including prompt design, structured outputs, context management, model selection, and API-based model integration.
  • Agentic AI: Experience designing AI agents and agentic workflows involving tool use, multi-step reasoning, orchestration, state management, and interaction with enterprise systems and APIs.
  • Retrieval & Grounding: Experience implementing grounding and retrieval patterns such as Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), embeddings, vector search, and enterprise knowledge retrieval where appropriate.
  • AI Evaluation: Experience developing evaluation frameworks for AI applications, including measuring response quality, reliability, groundedness, task completion, latency, and other relevant product metrics.
  • AI Engineering: Strong understanding of the challenges associated with production AI systems, including non-deterministic outputs, hallucinations, context management, failure handling, observability, model/version changes, and cost management.
  • Cloud & Deployment: Experience deploying AI-enabled applications in cloud environments, preferably GCP, and working with containerized environments such as Docker and Kubernetes.
  • API & Integration Design: Strong experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs and integrating AI capabilities into existing distributed applications and enterprise systems.
  • Software Craftsmanship: Strong understanding of clean-code principles, automated testing, CI/CD, Git workflows, observability, and maintainable software architecture.
  • Enterprise AI Platforms: Experience integrating applications with shared enterprise AI platforms, model gateways, or similar centralized AI capabilities is highly desirable.

Professional Skills

  • Technical Leadership & Enablement: Ability to provide hands-on technical leadership while deliberately transferring knowledge and capability to the existing development team.
  • Teaching & Mentorship: Strong ability to explain emerging AI concepts to experienced software developers and translate those concepts into practical engineering patterns, examples, and working solutions.
  • Product Thinking: Ability to evaluate AI opportunities based on user value, feasibility, reliability, and business impact rather than applying AI solely because the technology is available.
  • Problem Solving & Experimentation: Comfortable operating in an emerging technical space where requirements and implementation patterns may initially be ambiguous. Able to rapidly prototype, evaluate results, and turn successful experiments into maintainable production solutions.
  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Proven ability to work across product, engineering, analytics, architecture, and enterprise platform teams and establish alignment around technical approaches and responsibilities.
  • Communication: Ability to clearly communicate AI concepts, solution designs, limitations, risks, and technical tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Platform Mindset: Prioritizes reusable enterprise capabilities and established platform patterns over unnecessary custom infrastructure, while identifying and communicating gaps where platform capabilities do not meet product needs.
  • Responsible AI Development: Applies appropriate safeguards, testing, monitoring, access controls, and human oversight when introducing AI capabilities into business-critical workflows.
  • Continuous Learning: Maintains strong awareness of rapidly evolving LLM and Agentic AI technologies and translates relevant developments into practical recommendations for the team.

title: Agentic AI Developer
jobDescription:
We're looking for an Agentic AI Developer who lives at the intersection of applied LLM engineering and production software. You'll design and ship the AI agents and orchestration flows at the core of Synthetix reasoning loops, tool use, multi-agent coordination, memory, and the governance rails that keep them trustworthy.

You're comfortable across the stack, but your center of gravity is agent creation: turning a capability into a reliable, observable, evaluable agent. This is a hands-on builder role — you'll prototype fast, harden what works, and own agents from design through production.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and ship AI agents using modern agent frameworks — OpenAI Agents SDK, Google's Agent Development Kit (ADK), Microsoft Agent Framework / AutoGen, CrewAI, or equivalents — picking the right tool for each problem.
  • Architect multi-agent orchestration and stateful workflows with LangGraph, LangChain, and similar frameworks: planning, routing, hand-offs, retries, and durable long-running execution.
  • Implement robust tool / function calling, structured outputs, and external-system integration, including Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and connectors.
  • Build the retrieval and memory layers — RAG pipelines, embeddings, vector search, and short- and long-term agent memory.
  • Bake in governance from day one: guardrails, policy enforcement, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, audit trails, and safe-failure behavior — the governed in governed orchestration.
  • Stand up evaluation and observability — agent evals, LLM-as-judge, tracing, and telemetry (e.g., LangSmith, Langfuse, OpenTelemetry) — to measure and continuously improve agent reliability.
  • Integrate agents into full-stack applications across APIs, services, and front-end surfaces, collaborating closely with platform, product, and design.
  • Optimize for cost, latency, and quality across model providers (OpenAI, Anthropic / Claude, Google / Gemini, and open-weight models).

What You'll Bring

  • 3+ years building and shipping production software, with meaningful recent hands-on experience building AI agents or LLM-powered applications.
  • Strong Python (the working language of agent development) and solid TypeScript / JavaScript for full-stack integration.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one agent framework / SDK (OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar) and one orchestration framework (LangChain / LangGraph or equivalent).
  • A solid grasp of LLM building blocks: prompting, function / tool calling, structured outputs, context-window management, RAG, and embeddings / vector databases.
  • Full-stack fluency: REST / async APIs (FastAPI, NestJS, or similar), relational databases (PostgreSQL), and enough front-end (React) to build and integrate end-to-end.
  • Familiarity with cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP), containers (Docker), and CI/CD.
  • A product mindset, strong debugging instincts, and the judgment to make non-deterministic systems behave reliably.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with agent evaluation and LLM observability tooling (LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize, and similar).
  • Experience with MCP, Temporal or other durable-execution engines, and event-driven architectures.
  • Exposure to enterprise / regulated environments — SSO, RBAC, data governance, and compliance.
  • Fine-tuning, prompt-optimization, or model-routing experience.
  • Open-source contributions in the agent / LLM ecosystem.
